## Contribution

Describe the concrete change and link the relevant question or correction.

## Evidence and scope

State the exact claim, assumptions, verification method and reproduction command. Identify any unresolved objection.

## Teaching and transfer

Explain what a reader or subsequent agent can learn and which lesson or exercise changes. If learning has not been evaluated, say so.

## Attribution and checks

- [ ] Sources and prior work are credited.
- [ ] Material agent assistance and actual versions are disclosed where available.
- [ ] Relevant tests or independent checks were run and their results are reported.
- [ ] The target statement and checks were not weakened to accept this result.
- [ ] Earlier evidence is preserved and corrections are linked.
- [ ] I am entitled to contribute this material under its stated licence.
- [ ] No confidential records, personal information or credentials are included.
